FN-VOJUVL-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 26
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative David Standridge
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 03/17/2023
House Bill 26 as introduced will increase the salary expenses of the Blount County Board of
Registrars, paid from the State General Fund, by an estimated maximum of $10,076 annually.
The provisions of this act could also increase the mileage, travel, and other expenses
reimbursed to the Board from the State General Fund, by an undetermined amount dependent
upon the number of additional meeting days and the number of members in attendance.
